title: Normalized ordinary and derived adjoint lifts of ringed-topos morphisms
statement: For any two recorded ringed-site tensor presentations X and Y and ringed-topos morphism f : X → Y, there is an AdjointLift f: a scalar-extension RingedTensorEdge with its geometric inverse/direct images, ring map and ordinary Hom bijection identified with f, together with the universal right-derived unit, invertibility on K-injectives and flat-term K-flats, and the canonical derived inverse Hom formula. No tensor-coherence or comparison-between-morphisms assertion is made. The recorded presentations, edges, representative models and normalization equations are those defined in [def-sfb-ringed-derived-comparison-data].

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A6; Modules on Sites, Tag 03D7

proof.text:
transport the ring and its modules along the finite-limit-preserving inverse
image, and extend scalars along the given structural map. The supplied normalized
scalar-extension adjunction gives exactly the recorded underlying-sheaf Hom formula.
The K-flat resolving class constructs the universal left derived functor, while
K-injective derivability constructs the universal right derived functor. The
resolving-class derived adjunction gives the required transpose formula. Its
comparison maps are invertible on the two resolving classes.
